Why CSCG.

We're committed to collaboration, growth, inclusion, mentorship, and providing real-world experiences that prepare students for professional success.

How the process works.

1

Application

A brief questionnaire to get to know you, your skills, and your experiences.

2

Video Interview

An opportunity for you to provide context surrounding your skills and experience.

3

Interview

A one-on-one interview consisting of behavioral and technical sections.

Start your application

Application FAQ.

What does the application process look like?

There will be a preliminary application, followed by a group or individual case, and finally an individual interview.

What are we looking for in applications?

Curious, hardworking people who have made quantifiable impact.

What majors and qualifications is CSCG looking for?

We welcome candidates from all academic backgrounds and value diverse skill sets including creativity, analytics, and communication.

Additional questions

If you have a specific question not covered here, please contact us via the Contact page.
